title: William and Sarah Grey of 2010 Prairie get faces from stand-in portraits
items: No photograph of either Grey survives, so their faces are now fitted to two sepia portraits chosen as stand-ins, point by point over about 400 face points each, and drawn at the age the pictures show. Each card shows the portrait beside the model and marks it as a stand-in, not them.
William is heavy-set and thick-necked, with long wavy hair swept back, a full trimmed beard over his chin and cheeks, a full moustache and a dark brown three-piece suit.
Sarah is slight, her hair drawn up to a round knot high on her head, in a dark brown dress with a white lace collar.
